entities.name: DeepSeek

entities.name: ByteDance / Seed
entities.note: Major model/platform player omitted from global ecosystem; keep Seed/Doubao as brands under ByteDance. No direct supplier-payment amount established here.

entities.name: Groq

entities.name: G42
entities.note: Major sovereign AI/customer/financing hub. Do not automatically consolidate MBZUAI into G42 or make its listed portfolio companies aliases.

entities.name: Fluidstack
entities.note: Major Anthropic infrastructure partner. $50B is Anthropic's program scope, not a demonstrated payment to Fluidstack.

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.note: Already in circulation. Public benefit corporation describes legal form, not stock listing. No completed exchange listing established by reviewed primary evidence by cutoff.

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.note: Already in circulation. Filing/IPO plans are not completed listing; no ticker verified. 'Ant' is ambiguous with Ant Group—do not make automatic alias without user confirmation.

rules: An ecosystem entity need not have a money-flow edge. DeepSeek/ByteDance may be included as competitive/model nodes without fabricated procurement.
Public financials and stock returns attach to issuer, not every product/subsidiary. Do not double-count SpaceX + SpaceXAI/xAI + Cursor.
New listings require insufficient-history states; no annualized inferred 1Y/3Y return.
Public benefit corporation is not synonymous with exchange-listed company.
Nonlisted context means no verified exchange listing in reviewed primary evidence; no quoted market cap, stock return or audited-profit assumption.
Do not use 'Ant' automatically for Anthropic; Ant Group is another legal entity.
Separate funding, loan, acquisition share consideration, contract value, hardware purchases and recognized revenue. No sum across categories.
Edges identified as partnership/distribution/ownership require different visual styling from cash payment edges.
